oracleRisk.summary: USD3 nav values idle USDC and waUSDC shares using internal MorphoCredit expected-supply accounting. The live CreditLine mm points to the owner-gated MarkdownController, whose setEnableMarkdown changes impairment recognition and hence market supply assets feeding USD3 NAV. This is privileged internal pricing; generic Chainlink or TWAP statements do not establish an external USD3 NAV feed.
